title: Separating Spatial and Clinical Risk with Node-Splitting SVM Survival Trees
abstract: arXiv:2608.13847v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recovering geographic variation in survival requires separating spatial risk from patients' clinical characteristics, a problem complicated by prognostic covariates that are themselves spatially structured. We develop a nonparametric two-stage method for this separation. A clinical survival tree fit to the covariates alone supplies leaf Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazard residuals, transferring the censored survival structure to a clinically adjusted scale without imposing a functional form on the clinical hazard, and a second tree fit to these residuals on the coordinates recovers the spatial structure. Both stages are kernel dipole-splitting survival trees, so the resulting spatial risk map is piecewise constant, with sharp, possibly curved boundaries. We establish when the residuals recover the spatial signal: under a multiplicative frailty and an exogeneity condition, they are free of the clinical covariates given location and stochast

translated_title: 通过节点分裂SVM生存树分离空间风险与临床风险
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13847v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：恢复生存中的地理变异需要将空间风险与患者的临床特征分离，这一问题因预后协变量本身具有空间结构而变得复杂。我们开发了一种非参数两阶段方法来实现这种分离。首先，仅基于协变量拟合一个临床生存树，提供叶节点Nelson-Aalen累积风险残差，将删失生存结构转换为临床调整尺度，而不对临床风险施加函数形式；然后，基于这些残差在坐标上拟合第二棵树，以恢复空间结构。两个阶段均使用核偶极分裂生存树，因此得到的空间风险图是分段常数，具有尖锐且可能弯曲的边界。我们确定了残差何时能恢复空间信号：在乘法脆弱性和外生性条件下，给定位置时残差与临床协变量无关，并具有随机性。
tldr: 本文提出一种非参数两阶段方法，通过核偶极分裂生存树分离空间风险与临床风险，无需预设函数形式，并能生成具有尖锐边界的空间风险图。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a nonparametric two-stage method using kernel dipole-splitting survival trees to separate spatial risk from clinical risk, without imposing functional forms, yielding spatial risk maps with sharp boundaries.
